hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech; $s = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer; $v = $s.GetInstalledVoices() | Where-Object { $_.VoiceInfo.Culture.Name -like 'es*' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($v) { $s.SelectVoice($v.VoiceInfo.Name) }; $s.Speak('Terminé la tarea.')"
